description: Source code for the Android IMediaPlayer interface implementation, including BpMediaPlayer class and onTransact method handling media player commands.

classes.name: BpMediaPlayer
classes.description: Proxy class for IMediaPlayer interface, providing methods to control media playback.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the media player service.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the data source for media playback, either via URL, file descriptor, or stream source.

methods.name: setVideoSurfaceTexture
methods.description: Passes a surface texture to the media player for video output.

methods.name: prepareAsync
methods.description: Prepares the media player asynchronously.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts media playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops media playback.

methods.name: isPlaying
methods.description: Checks if media is currently playing.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses media playback.

methods.name: seekTo
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the media.

methods.name: getCurrentPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback position.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Retrieves the duration of the media.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the media player to its uninitialized state.

methods.name: setAudioStreamType
methods.description: Sets the audio stream type.

methods.name: setLooping
methods.description: Sets whether the media should loop.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the playback volume.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Invokes a custom command with a parcel request.

methods.name: setMetadataFilter
methods.description: Sets a filter for metadata retrieval.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves media metadata.

methods.name: setAuxEffectSendLevel
methods.description: Sets auxiliary effect send level.

methods.name: attachAuxEffect
methods.description: Attaches an auxiliary effect.

methods.name: setParameter
methods.description: Sets a parameter for the media player.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value.

methods.name: setRetransmitEndpoint
methods.description: Sets the retransmit endpoint address.

methods.name: setNextPlayer
methods.description: Sets the next media player for seamless playback.
